issues.description: resolve(from, '..', s) breaks when source paths are absolute or schema-prefixed URLs
issues.detail: The old code resolved sources relative to the map URL itself; the new code joins from + '..' + s. For absolute source paths (common in source maps) this still works since resolve discards earlier segments, but for relative sources from a map at /pkg/dist/file.js.map, the old code resolved relative to /pkg/dist/, while new code resolves relative to /pkg/. This shifts the base directory up by one and may break existing inlined source map handling.

issues.description: Synchronous fs reads inside stack trace parsing block the event loop on every error
issues.detail: getSourceMap is called for each frame in a stack and uses readFileSync plus existsSync, potentially reading large external module files and their referenced map files synchronously. With long stacks across many node_modules files this can noticeably stall reporting. Consider memoizing per-file results within a test run to avoid repeated disk reads for the same file across frames/errors.

issues.description: No caching of extracted source maps across frames or errors
issues.detail: Each frame in each error triggers a fresh readFileSync + convertSourceMap parse for the same external module. A stack with N frames from the same transpiled file does N full reads and parses. A simple Map<filePath, SourceMap|undefined> cache (scoped to the test run or project) would dramatically reduce overhead when many tests fail in the same dependency.

issues.description: createConvertSourceMapReadMap returns '{}' which is not a valid source map
issues.detail: When a referenced external .map file is missing, the fallback returns '{}' to avoid errors. An empty object lacks required fields (version, mappings) and may still throw inside trace-mapping depending on consumer. Returning a minimally valid stub like '{"version":3,"sources":[],"mappings":""}' would be safer.

issues.description: Unused path import via pathe vs node:path inconsistency
issues.detail: The file already imports resolve from 'pathe' for cross-platform path handling, but the new code introduces node:path and uses path.resolve/path.dirname. Mixing the two on Windows can produce inconsistent separators. Prefer pathe consistently throughout this module.

issues.description: No new test exercises the source-map.ts resolve() change directly
issues.detail: The snapshot update in stacktraces.test.ts confirms the end-to-end behavior for external modules, but the DecodedMap resolvedSources change has broad implications for any consumer of decoded maps. A direct unit test asserting resolvedSources for representative source map shapes (relative, absolute, with sourceRoot) would guard against regressions.

review.summary: The fix correctly applies source maps to external module stack traces by hooking parseErrorStacktrace's getSourceMap callback and reading map files from disk. Main concerns: the resolve(from, '..', s) change in DecodedMap shifts the base directory up one level vs the original resolve(s, from), which may regress relative-source resolution for inlined maps; and the new readSync-based extraction has no caching, doing repeated disk I/O per stack frame. Empty-map fallback '{}' is technically invalid. Otherwise the implementation is clean and the snapshot test confirms the user-visible fix.
